prompt: In many countries, an increasing number of people are choosing to work from home rather than travel to an office every day. Some people believe that this is a positive trend that benefits both employees and employers. Others, however, think that working in an office is more productive and better for team spirit. Discuss both views and give your opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
essay:
In many countries, more people now work remotely instead of going to an office every day. Some people think this is good for both employees and employers. Others think working in an office is better for teamwork. In my opinion, working in an office is the better choice because it helps people work together and learn from others.

People who support working from home have one good reason: it reduces commuting time. Employees who work from home do not have to commute to the office. For example, a person who lives far from the office can save two hours every day. This time can be used to finish tasks or to rest, which improves their work-life balance. Because of this, they feel less stressed and are more productive, and employers get better results.

However, I believe that working in an office is better, because employees can get guidance from experienced colleagues. For example, a new employee can ask a colleague for advice and solve a problem in a few minutes. At home, he may wait a long time for an email reply. In an office, people can discuss ideas face to face and help each other with new tasks. Because of this, he gains experience faster and makes fewer mistakes. This also helps the company, because the team collaborates more effectively.

In conclusion, working from home reduces commuting time and can help both workers and companies. However, I believe that working in an office is better, because workers can get guidance from others and gain experience faster. This is why the office is the better choice.
